To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We present a model for an interaction strategy for an agent to follow in a multi-user system.

we have developed a model for an intelligent agent to reason about interacting with multiple users, that the model is based on a user modeling approach and that we have implemented and tested our model in a collaborative environment and have demonstrated its effectiveness in that environment.
1) the interaction strategy of an agent can be modeled in a principled fashion, 2) the model is able to handle multiple users, 3) the model is based on a user modeling approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to reason about interaction in a collaborative environment, where the users are interacting with a single agent, but are not necessarily cooperating with each other.
the design of a model of interaction for a multi-user system, and the development of a system that incorporates that model.
the problem of how to best ask a user for information, in order to maximize expected utility.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model is a good approach to reasoning about interaction with multiple agents, and it has a lot to offer.
our model is the first of its kind to address all of the issues we have discussed.
this paper is an excellent contribution to the literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a model to reason about interaction in a multi-user system, where the agent can determine who to ask and when, and can determine the appropriate follow up questions to ask.

we have developed a model that can be applied to the reasoning about interaction in a collaborative environment and that it is a step forward towards developing a more intelligent agent that is able to interact with multiple users in an intelligent way.
the model provides for a more efficient interaction between agents and users, and is more flexible and robust than previous approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to have an agent reason about interaction with users in a way that is sensitive to individual differences.
a user modeling approach is effective in modeling interaction, with a focus on the specific factors that are relevant to each user.
the agent should not assume that users will respond to questions in a predictable manner, and that it should take into account the possibility of a user not knowing an answer.
